You are purchasing a "Box of 60 Blank White Audio Cassette Tapes" in "Used" condition.
Selling a bulk box of blank white audio cassette tapes, perfect for recording music, spoken word, church services, mixtapes, or duplications. The original Gamma 2000 / Long's Electronics box is opened, but the cassettes inside appear unused and are still neatly stacked, many in factory-style plastic wrap. Ideal for anyone who still loves the warm, nostalgic sound of tape or needs a reliable batch of blanks for projects, archiving, or resale. Harder to find in bulk like this, these tapes offer a great opportunity to stock up in one shot. Includes approximately 60 blank white cassette tapes in one box.
